programme.title: Pumping iron
programme.desc: Arnold Schwarzenegger est à l'affiche de ce documentaire sur les 100 jours qui précàdent le concours de Mr Olympia de 1975.

programme.title: Discovering Canary Islands: Afleveringen 1-2
programme.desc: Afleveringe: Lanzarote - Fuerteventura. Het avontuur begint op Lanzarote. Na de vorming van twee teams zullen onze deelnemers voor het eerst tegenover elkaar staan in verschillende proeven.

programme.title: Kampioenen
programme.desc: Pia Sundhage, drievoudig Olympisch medaillewinnaar en FIFA Damescoach van het jaar in 2012 vertelt hoe ze zich voelde toen ze voor het eerst werd opgeroepen voor het Zweedse nationale damesteam.

programme.title: The Giants - De sumohelden van Hawaï
programme.desc: We volgen de legendarische levens van de sumohelden die zich na een bescheiden start in Hawaï als eerste buitenlanders hebben opgewerkt tot de hoogste gelederen van het sumoworstelen.

programme.title: HairStyle, The Talent Show USA: Afleveringen 5-6
programme.desc: Afleveringen: 5-6. Niet elke klant is moeilijk te plezieren, maar de klanten moeten de salon tevreden verlaten. In de 2e uitdaging gaan de deelnemers aan de slag met de haarkleur, waarbij ze veel aandacht aan de verzorging besteden.

programme.title: I Am Breathing
programme.desc: “I AM BREATHING” herinnert ons eraan wat het is om te leven – een verhaal waarin veel wordt gelachen maar waarin ook plaats is voor verdriet en ellende.

programme.title: Ride your Dream
programme.desc: De motorsport was een typische mannenwereld, tot nu. In deze documentaire maken we kennis met Ana Carrasco, de Spaanse motorrijder die de wereld van de motorraces heeft gerevolutioneerd en die sinds haar prilste jeugd maar één droom had: wereldkampioen worden.

programme.title: Mijn Beslissing, door Andrés Iniesta
programme.desc: Een onthullende documentaire waarin we de legendarische middenvelder Andrés Iniesta volgen terwijl hij een cruciale beslissing moet nemen na een carrièrebedreigende blessure.

programme.title: Fast Forward
programme.desc: Fast Forward is een documentaireserie van vijf afleveringen die in de toekomst kijkt door middel van opkomende technologieën die zijn gericht op het aanpakken van enkele van de meest vitale uitdagingen waarmee de wereld vandaag wordt geconfronteerd.

programme.title: Ona Carbonell: Opnieuw beginnen
programme.desc: In augustus 2020 werd Olympisch artistiek zwemster Ona Carbonell voor het eerst moeder, een ervaring die haar leven van de ene op de andere dag veranderde.

programme.title: De geheimen van La Roja - Wereldkampioenen 2010
programme.desc: Op 11 juli 2010 won het Spaanse nationale elftal de Wereldbeker, een overwinning voor het team én het hele land. Maar vóór dit legendarische succes moest “La Roja” wel eerst heel wat moeilijkheden overwinnen.

programme.title: SEVE - Artiest, Vechter, Legende
programme.desc: Seve Ballesteros was 'n kunstenaar: een golfende Picasso, een waar genie van het spel, een sportief icoon. Hij was een vechter die eerst vocht om golf te spelen bij de lokale club en later tegen langdurige rugblessures, rivalen op de golfbaan, een uiteenvallende swing en tot slot een hersentumor.

programme.title: Marcus
programme.desc: Patrick Savey dompelt ons onder in de wereld van Marcus en legt de New Yorkse roots van de legendarische bassist vast, terwijl hij zijn pad volgt als de kruimeltjes van Klein Duimpje, terwijl hij meesters van de jazz ontmoet.

programme.title: Corumbiara
programme.desc: Na een massale moordpartij door landeigenaren in Corumbiara, een gemeente in het westen van Brazilië...

programme.title: Last Man Standing: Suge Knight and the Murders of Biggie and Tupac
programme.desc: Het verhaal van Suge Knight, onlangs veroordeeld tot 28 jaar gevangenisstraf wegens doodslag. Deze film toont nieuw materiaal en nooit eerder gehoord bewijsmateriaal en is het definitieve verhaal van Suge en de moorden op Biggie en Tupac.

programme.title: Het programmeren wordt binnenkort hervat.
programme.desc: We halen ons schoonheidsslaapje in! Blijf op de hoogte voor nog meer onschatbaar entertainment, samengesteld door Rakuten TV.

programme.title: HairStyle The Talent Show USA: Afleveringen 1-2
programme.desc: Afleveringen: 1-2. In de eerste aflevering stellen de deelnemers zich aan de jury voor, vertrouwend op hun vindingrijkheid om een freestyle look te creëren. TV persoonlijkheid en mode influencer Tina Leung zal de salon bezoeken om commentaar te geven op de haarverzorgingsroutines.

programme.title: 265 Days Without Waves (265 dagen zonder golven)
programme.desc: Een uniek en buitengewoon verhaal over surfen aan de Middellandse Zeekust van Barcelona. Met nauwelijks 100 dagen golven per jaar slaagt een groep lokale surfers erin om tegen alle verwachtingen in een gemeenschap te creëren en een surfcultuur te promoten.

programme.title: Bojan, achter de glimlach
programme.desc: Bojan Krkic had het succes in de palm van zijn hand, maar de moeilijkheden waarmee hij als vroegrijp talent te maken kreeg, hebben zijn carrière gemarkeerd sinds hij als 16-jarige bij FC Barcelona debuteerde. Hij is een duidelijk voorbeeld van de druk die jonge talenten in de sport ondervinden.

programme.title: De geheimen van La Roja - Wereldkampioenen 2010
programme.desc: Op 11 juli 2010 won het Spaanse nationale elftal de Wereldbeker, een overwinning voor het team én het hele land. Maar vóór dit legendarische succes moest “La Roja” wel eerst heel wat moeilijkheden overwinnen.

programme.title: Karate-do: Het Pad van Sandra Sánchez
programme.desc: Sandra Sánchez is geen furie, hoewel je dat in de dojo soms wel zou denken. De transformatie is des te opmerkelijker als we over de uitdagingen in haar leven horen.

programme.title: Barcelona: Surf Destination
programme.desc: Voor het eerst in de geschiedenis wordt surfen in Tokyo 2020 als Olympische sport beschouwd en heeft het zijn eerste kampioen: Ítalo Ferreira. De gouden medaillewinnaar verlaat de stranden van Brazilië om naar Barcelona te reizen, waar hij de lokale surfscene ziet en hoe de mensen er zijn.

programme.title: Ona Carbonell: Opnieuw beginnen
programme.desc: In augustus 2020 werd Olympisch artistiek zwemster Ona Carbonell voor het eerst moeder, een ervaring die haar leven van de ene op de andere dag veranderde.

programme.title: Kampioenen
programme.desc: Carolina Morace onthult zichzelf, in Rome, als een vrouw met karakter, niet bang om de eerste vrouw te zijn in wat dan ook, zoals de eerste die vier doelpunten maakt in het Wembley Stadium.

programme.title: Discovering Canary Islands: Afleveringen 3-4
programme.desc: Afleveringen: Gran Canaria - Tenerife. Pilar Rubio verwelkomt een vertegenwoordiger van elk team in het natuurpark de Teide, de hoogste bergtop van Spanje.

programme.title: Bojan, achter de glimlach
programme.desc: Bojan Krkic had het succes in de palm van zijn hand, maar de moeilijkheden waarmee hij als vroegrijp talent te maken kreeg, hebben zijn carrière gemarkeerd sinds hij als 16-jarige bij FC Barcelona debuteerde. Hij is een duidelijk voorbeeld van de druk die jonge talenten in de sport ondervinden.

programme.title: HairStyle, The Talent Show USA: Afleveringen 3-4
programme.desc: Afleveringen: 3-4. De 1e uitdaging is stylen in de meest kritische omgeving te stylen: bruiloft. Daarna gaan de deelnemers het beschadigde haar van de klanten van de salon herstellen.

programme.title: Body, le corps du frère (Brother's Body)
programme.desc: David Nicolas Parel dompelt zich (opnieuw) onder in bodybuilding en probeert zijn jongere broer te volgen, terwijl hij traint voor de Arnold Classic - Arnold, van de beroemde Oostenrijks/Amerikaanse acteur en politicus.

programme.title: Last Man Standing: Suge Knight and the Murders of Biggie and Tupac
programme.desc: Het verhaal van Suge Knight, onlangs veroordeeld tot 28 jaar gevangenisstraf wegens doodslag. Deze film toont nieuw materiaal en nooit eerder gehoord bewijsmateriaal en is het definitieve verhaal van Suge en de moorden op Biggie en Tupac.

programme.title: Trading Paradise
programme.desc: Van Zwitserland tot Zambia, via de Amazone en Peru, is TRADING PARADISE een kritische blik achter de schermen van de grondstoffensector en de ecologische en menselijke gevolgen ervan.

programme.title: Paradiso
programme.desc: Rafael is de operateur van de laatste bioscoop voor volwassenen in Madrid. Hij gelooft dat hij zijn werk elke dag beter kan doen dan de dag ervoor.

programme.title: Het programmeren wordt binnenkort hervat.
programme.desc: We halen ons schoonheidsslaapje in! Blijf op de hoogte voor nog meer onschatbaar entertainment, samengesteld door Rakuten TV.

programme.title: Beyond Sixty
programme.desc: Opgevat als een soort carrousel van inspirerende verhalen van vrouwen boven de zestig, zal deze documentaire je vooroordelen over ouderdom en vrouwelijkheid veranderen.

programme.title: Make Up Stars: Afleveringen 5-6
programme.desc: Afleveringen: Natuur - En de winnaar is... In de halve finale staan de deelnemers voor een bodypainting-uitdaging waarin ze een van de vier natuurelementen moeten uitbeelden, onder deskundige begeleiding van Corinne Pérez.

programme.title: Ettore Bassi: Stage and Race
programme.desc: Ettore Bassi is bekend als acteur, maar niet iedereen weet dat hij ook een professioneel heuvelklimracer is. Tegenwoordig verdeelt hij zijn leven tussen het toneel en de racebaan. In 2022 komen beide passies in botsing en zo ontdekken we het een en ander over de man en zijn verleden...

programme.title: Discovering Canary Islands 2: Afleveringen 6-7
programme.desc: Afleveringen: La Gomera - El Hierro. De reis gaat verder in La Gomera, met een eerste proef in het lommerrijke nationale park Garajonay.

programme.title: HairStyle, The Talent Show USA: Afleveringen 3-4
programme.desc: Afleveringen: 3-4. De 1e uitdaging is stylen in de meest kritische omgeving te stylen: bruiloft. Daarna gaan de deelnemers het beschadigde haar van de klanten van de salon herstellen.

programme.title: Kampioenen
programme.desc: Familie Flores ontbijt, luncht en dineert met voetbal in het achterhoofd. De jonge zussen Tatiana en Silvana trainen met hun vader, een voormalige Mexicaanse voetballer, en krijgen van hem alle ervaring die ze nodig hebben voor hun carrière.

programme.title: Rumeysa: Het leven met lengte
programme.desc: Na een leven vol fysieke uitdagingen en tegenslagen is 's werelds langste vrouw klaar om haar droom waar te maken en naar Californië in de VS te reizen. Haar missie: bewustzijn verspreiden voor mensen met zichtbare verschillen.

programme.title: Discovering Canary Islands 2: Afleveringen 4-5
programme.desc: Afleveringen: Tenerife - La Palma. Het avontuur gaat verder op Tenerife en een eerste opdracht met de indrukwekkende Acantilados de los Gigantes als decor en een catamaran en een estafette in kajaks.

programme.title: Kampioenen
programme.desc: Carmen Arce, "Kubalita", doelvrouw van het eerste Spaanse vrouwenteam, gaat van Valencia naar Barcelona om Alexia Putellas, winnares van de UEFA Champions League en UEFA Super Cup, en Viktoria Adrianova, beide speelsters van FC Barcelona, te ontmoeten.

programme.title: Transvulcania, de race van het volk
programme.desc: Transvulcania is één van de meest iconische trailrunningevenementen ter wereld. Het is een race die de locals echt als eigen voelen. Deze documentaire verdiept zich in de persoonlijke verhalen van de atleten en de bewoners van het eiland, die jaren van tegenspoed hebben meegemaakt.

programme.title: The Cat's Meow
programme.desc: In 1924 heeft mediamagnaat William Randolph Hearst de grootste beroemdheden ter wereld verzameld voor een reis op zijn jacht die leidt tot een nog steeds onopgeloste, geheim gehouden moord.

programme.title: De Eetclub
programme.desc: Karen en Michel, begin dertigers, verhuizen met hun dochtertje naar een exclusieve villawijk. Al snel vindt Karen een hechte vriendenkring in de vrouwen van De Eetclub en hun echtgenoten.

programme.title: The Honor List
programme.desc: Drie voormalige beste vrienden herenigen zich wanneer het vierde lid van hun groep plotseling overlijdt tijdens hun laatste jaar van de middelbare school. Ze besluiten de bucketlist die ze tijdens hun eerstejaarsjaar hebben gemaakt, compleet te maken, toen de vier nog dichtbij waren.

programme.title: After The Wedding
programme.desc: Michelle Williams speelt Isabel, de manager van een weeshuis in Calcutta., die op een uitnodiging ingaat van zakenvrouw Theresa (Julianne Moore) in New York die haar wil inlijven bij haar organisatie. In ruil daarvoor zal Isabel het noodlijdende weeshuis voorzien van de nodige financiële support...

programme.title: Dansen op de vulkaan
programme.desc: Het verhaal draait om Maarten (Nils Verkooijen), een jongen van 16 die supergoed kan dansen. Elk uurtje dat hij over heeft, is hij in de dansschool te vinden. Maar Maarten draagt een geheim met zich mee dat maar weinig mensen kennen.

programme.title: I Still Believe
programme.desc: De steeds populairder wordende popster Jeremy en Melissa worden smoorverliefd op elkaar. Niets kan Jeremy zijn liefde voor Melissa doen wankelen, ook niet wanneer er kanker bij Melissa wordt ontdekt...

programme.title: Sex, Lies & Obsession
programme.desc: Iedereen die dr. Cameron Thomas kent, zou denken dat hij alles had – een geweldige vrouw, een succesvolle praktijk en twee prachtige zoons. Maar achter de schone schijn heeft hij een gevaarlijke seksverslaving die, als hij aan het licht komt, zijn hele leven op zijn kop zet.

programme.title: Caged
programme.desc: Stella (Chantal Demming) onderdrukt al jaren haar diepgewortelde verlangens. Haar huwelijk kabbelt voort en ze voelt zich niet meer begeerd. Uiteindelijk kan ze haar gevoelens niet langer negeren en begint een dubbelleven.

programme.title: Love and a .45
programme.desc: Nadat een overval dodelijk eindigt, vluchten de professionele crimineel Watty en zijn vriendin Starlene tijdens een wilde, meth-achtige en lsd-gevoede huwelijksreis/joyride richting de Mexicaanse grens.

programme.title: Het programmeren wordt binnenkort hervat.

programme.desc: Lea Meyer is gelukkig, haar man Harry adoreert haar, brengt het geld met bakken binnen en is, net als Lea zelf, dol op seks. Kortom; Lea's leven is perfect, totdat Harry zegt dat hij een kind wil.

programme.title: People You May Know
programme.desc: Jed, een introvert van in de dertig, heeft het tot nu toe volgehouden om zich van sociale media te onthouden. Wanneer hij de gigantische taak krijgt om te definiëren wie hij is, beseft hij dat het leven dat hij kan veinzen veel interessanter is dan het leven dat hij daadwerkelijk leidt.

programme.title: Pushing Tin
programme.desc: Nick Falzone is de nummer één luchtverkeersleider totdat een stille vreemdeling, Russell Bell, wordt overgeplaatst naar de afdeling. De rivaliteit tussen de twee beste luchtverkeersleiders op New York TRACON escaleert tot een potentieel gevaarlijk niveau.

programme.title: De Eetclub

programme.title: The Forger
programme.desc: Ray Cutter is een kruimeldief die erin slaagt om zich uit de gevangenis te 'kopen' zodat hij tijd kan doorbrengen met zijn zieke zoon. Maar Ray en zijn vader moeten samen nog één laatste grote klus doen om het syndicaat dat zijn vroegtijdige vrijlating financierde terug te betalen.

programme.title: High Crimes
programme.desc: Het leven van een vrouw raakt verwikkeld in een enorme, militaire cover-up als onthuld wordt dat haar man niet is wie hij zegt dat hij is.

programme.title: Oorlogswinter

programme.title: An Affair
programme.desc: Anita is tweeënveertig, woont in een klein plaatsje in Noorwegen samen met haar man en heeft een weinig sprankelend huwelijk. Wanneer ze met haar nieuwe baan als gymdocente op een middelbare school start, is haar achttienjarige leerling Marcus meteen gecharmeerd van haar...

programme.title: Pistol for a Hundred Coffins
programme.desc: Returning from the Civil War, Jim Slade finds his parents murdered and blames Corbett’s gang. Seeking revenge, he takes a job as sheriff to fund his pursuit, only to discover the truth behind the crime is far more complex than he imagined.

programme.title: Bonanza Compilation Episodes 43, 44, 45
programme.desc: De Wild West-avonturen van Ben Cartwright en zijn zoons terwijl ze hun ranch in Nevada runnen en verdedigen terwijl ze de omringende gemeenschap helpen.

programme.title: Up the Dish
programme.desc: Get ready for a not-so-raw deal in this episode of Up the Dish! Host Poppy Sandler sets things in motion and slices up a simple, elegant Sashimi with tangy Ponzu and tart Wasabi Mayo on the side. Missy Hui gets carnivorous with Lamb Carpaccio and Dukkah - delicate raw lamb and a Middle Eastern-style dip served with some delicious pita! But wait, what's a vegetarian to do with all this meat? Tiera Singh's got the answer - island-style Poke Bowls, with fruit instead of fish. Refreshing watermelon is marinated in a savoury, soy-based sauce and served with rice. For the finale, Micah Trainor Up('s) the Dish with her Scallop Tartare and Beet Chips, combining raw scallops with ultra-decadent...

programme.title: One World Kitchen: Our Favourite Holiday Recipes
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 One World Kitchen: Our Favourite Holiday Recipes
programme.desc: In this special holiday episode of One World Kitchen, Hana (Japan), Vanessa (Italy), Natalia (Argentina), and Pailin (Thailand) get together to cook their favorite traditional holiday dishes influenced by their respective cultures. Christmas Sushi Rolls, Veal in a Creamy Tuna Sauce with Capers, Striped Bass in Garlic and Lime Marinade, and an epic Timballo. For the final recipe, our hosts combine all the flavors of One World Kitchen into a truly internationally-inspired turkey dish.

programme.title: Griddle Nation
programme.desc: A symbol of comfort and city pride, the Philly cheesesteak continues to inspire fresh imagination. Thin-sliced steak, melting cheese, and griddled bread set the foundation as new flavors and regional twists bring this iconic sandwich into a new era of creativity.

programme.title: Holiday Eatz
programme.desc: Summer Solstice is celebrated around the world with all manner of ritual and fun"... Holiday Eatz host Kimberly Lallouz is celebrating with a party menu that takes advantage of all those extra hours of sun! Homemade cheese in one day? You bet! It's easy and delicious in her Watermelon Salad with white balsamic vinegar and sunflower seed brittle. Her next course is grilled shrimp, scallops, avocados, and peaches? Yep! Washed down with a citrus spiked white sangria! A crispy skin pork belly Porchetta roast is next, stuffed with savoury summer herbs. For her finale, you'll love her rhubarb meringue pie, it's a mile high pie for a mile-wide smile"... what a way to spend the longest day!

programme.title: Griddle Nation
programme.desc: Around the world in one meal, global flavors come together on the griddle. Vibrant spices, sauces, and ingredients mix to form creative fusions that celebrate connection through food, offering a taste of adventure in every sizzling, flavorful bite.

programme.title: Flour Power
programme.desc: Make hosting your next shower a cinch with Jessica McGovern's simple and super cute recipes - like tiny Oatmeal Cookie Cheesecake Cups!

programme.title: A is for Apple
programme.desc: Here's a tongue twister: Theresa, tuna, tangerine! In this episode, host Theresa Visintin picks her favourite letter, "T," and introduces us to scrumptious recipes using tuna and tangerine. Theresa loves tuna and Italian cuisine, so naturally she combines both to create a mouth-watering pasta with some savoury tomato, olive, and tuna sauce. Next, Theresa satisfies her sweet tooth with a decadent tangerine parfait! Using the sweet juice of the tangerine, Theresa creates gelatin, with a hint of orange liqueur. She tops it all off by whipping up a fluffy cream to complete this sweet treat. Then it's time for a real challenge: tuna and tangerine in one recipe!

programme.title: A is for Apple
programme.desc: In this "H" challenge, Chef Lauren Gulyas decides to take on the unique flavours of halibut and horseradish. She starts with a perfectly prepared prosciutto wrapped halibut, pairing the buttery flavour of the fish with the saltiness of the cured meat. Throw in some dill potatoes and you've got a beautifully balanced dish. Dusted in Middle Eastern Spices, flame roasted and served with chili-spiked, Yemeni 'Skhug' hot sauce and pomegranate seeds. Finally, Spencer steams tender artichokes, stuffing these flowers with breadcrumbs and...

Spencer then introduces us to Calabrian chilies, mashed into a spice paste and rubbed on butterflied chicken that then gets grilled to flame-kissed perfection. Finally, Spencer prepares Seekh Kabobs, made with ground lamb spiked with punchy dried Kashmiri chilies...

Finally, Spencer prepares a classic Spanish recipe: Paella. Loaded saffron rice, piled high with chorizo, veggies, and shellfish. Of course, Spencer's Paella is made in the Spanish tradition;...

Scallops are next, grilled and served with a mouth-watering caper-raisin butter. For his final recipe; Chef Watts prepares a rich and juicy grilled Rib Steak topped with a decadent port wine compound butter. Oh, what a butter-loving...

For his final recipe, Spencer takes it to a sweet level with his Chocolate pizza made with chocolate ganache, grilled cherries, with barbeque- caramelized white chocolate...

programme.title: Watts On the Grill
programme.sub-title: S02 : E02 Allium in the Family
programme.desc: Onions, green onions, chives, garlic, and leeks are all members of the same fabulous flowering family, Allium! First up? Chef Watts shows us his sweet and smoky Charred Leeks with Romesco; add grilled toast and you have your next party appetizer! Next up is a main course. Spencer starts with a juicy grilled pork chop, then adds roasted garlic melted into a balsamic onion chutney to make his out-of-this-world Roasted Garlic Pork Chops. Looking for a crowd pleaser that's easy to make? Spencer has a recipe for that! Chicken Yakitori. He threads skewers with crunchy green onions and tender chicken and caramelizes the yakitori sauce as he grills this tasty dish. Are you ready to drool? Spencer...

programme.title: Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: Have a cheese lover coming over? Blow their minds with some of Spencer's "grate" barbecued cheese recipes! First up, Spencer chars Brie Cheese to an ooey-gooey perfection and tops it with tart cherries and crunchy walnuts, serving it with crispy grilled crostinis. Next up is a Grilled Steak and Caesar with a twist only Spencer could add - grilled... lettuce! Then, Spencer uses the classic German "hasselback" presentation to stuff chicken breasts with verdant spinach, yummy Swiss cheese and pungent sun- dried tomatoes, grilling them to melty perfection. Finally, Spencer fires up his barbecue to make his Grilled Peaches with Salted Bourbon Caramel, a decadent dessert elevated with creamy...

programme.title: Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: In this bacon loving episode, Chef Spencer delivers a tasty Bacon Weave Turkey Breast, which gets injected with beer and spices before being wrapped up in its cozy bacon blanket and sent off to the grill! Next up? A Peameal Bacon Roast with Rosti. This heavy hunk of back bacon gets smoked to flavourful perfection while Chef Watts makes the crispiest golden-fried-to-perfection potato pancake. Then, Spencer whips up a charry, grilled, super decadent, bacon-wrapped and bacon stuffed cheeseburger. Spencer isn't finished with bacon yet! For his final recipe, Spencer stuffs an apple with decadent crispy morsels stuffed along with savoury caramelized onions and melty cheddar cheese.

programme.title: Geared Up S1 - "The 3.5"
programme.desc: A rare 1971 Mercedes Benz 280 SE 3.5 Coupe gets restored to its original specifications.

programme.title: Geared Up S1 - "Pinky"
programme.desc: A pink, air-cooled, 1973 Porsche 911 RS is upgraded with a custom built engine, new paint, and new wheels and tires.

programme.title: Geared Up S1 - "Benzilla"
programme.desc: A slow and outdated 1959 Mercedes Benz 180 D is modified with a bargain budget to include new wheels and an American V8 muscle motor.

programme.title: Geared Up S1 - "The Track T"
programme.desc: A 1972 Ford Track T Roadster is incomplete and needs Titan Restorarion;s finishing touch with its flathead V8 engine.

programme.title: Geared Up S1 - "The T Bird"
programme.desc: A 1957 Ford Thunderbird gets the restoration treatment with new paint, interior, and a rebuilt V8 motor.

programme.title: Geared Up S1 - "The 300"
programme.desc: An ultra rare 1957 Mercedes Benz 300 SL Roadster is resto-modded using a modern Mercedes Benz SLK 230 as a donor vehicle.

programme.title: The Hunt for Monster Bass S1 - "Back-alley Bass"
programme.desc: Host Ott DeFoe hunts down double-digit Largemouth Bass in the alleyways and cuts of these northern Florida waters.

programme.title: The Hunt for Monster Bass S1 - "Monster Bass in Lost Waters"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E09 Monster Bass in Lost Waters
programme.desc: Host Ott DeFoe hunts down double-digit Largemouth Bass in waters that haven't been fished in decades.

programme.title: The New Fly Fisher S17 - "Esnagami Lake Lodge"
programme.desc: Mikey Metcalfe visit this famous lodge for the first time, fishing for wild brook trout and northern pike on a fly.

programme.title: The New Fly Fisher S17 - "Gander River Outfitters"
programme.desc: Host Mark Melnyk travels to Newfoundland in search of big Atlantic Salmon.

programme.title: South Seas Spearo S2 - "North Minerva Reef"
programme.desc: After punching their way to North Minerva, the fellas continue their quest to land a big pelagic, but the local toothies threaten to throw a spanner into the team’s plans. Can they bag a tropical trophy, or will the sharks rain on their parade?

programme.title: South Seas Spearo S2 - "Yellowfin Mission"
programme.desc: Word's gotten out about some massive yellowfin baitballs, so the team head out in search of more tuna glory. Dwane, Kieran, Sam and Dave then bounce over the ditch for a few days diving the stunning waters of the Great Barrier Reef.

programme.title: The Trail S1 - "Permanent Residence"
programme.desc: Laramy and 7 find a long term camping spot out of the snow and at a lower elevation. Laramy gets to work making a more permanent shelter and looking for food.

programme.title: The Trail S1 - "Focused on Food"
programme.desc: Laramy locates some whitetail deer and focuses his efforts on hunting them.

programme.title: Wardens S5 - "Never Ending Day"
programme.desc: The Warden's day starts early with an opportunity to capture a convicted game violator who has dodged the law for over 3 years. But just as one case closes another begins - forcing them to work late into the night.

programme.title: Wardens S5 - "Angry Like a Moose"
programme.sub-title: S05 : E02 Angry Like a Moose
programme.desc: Region 4 Wardens are called in to round up a 1000 pound bully. But this youngster is not leaving the safety of his home. The Wardens turn to drastic measures to secure the situation.

programme.title: Gold Fever S1 - "Glacier Gold"
programme.desc: Tom and his son Kael are underneath a huge glacier, metal detecting for gold nuggets.

programme.title: Gold Fever S1 - "The Ghosts of Pine Log"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E04 The Ghosts of Pine Log
programme.desc: By paying a visit to the old Pine Log property in California Tom and his daughter Kia are re-tracing old footsteps.

programme.title: Gold Fever S1 - "Burnt River"
programme.desc: Tom and his daughter Kia are sluicing in Eastern Oregon, looking for gold.

programme.title: Gold Fever S1 - "Golden Flight"
programme.desc: Tom Massie and his son Kael are dredging in Anchorage, trying to find some gold for Cindy’s birthday gift.

programme.title: Fight to Survive S3 - "Nightmare Canyon - Part 1"
programme.desc: Justin and Jeremy Harris’ weekend decent into a remote Utah canyon becomes a survival nightmare when Justin severely breaks his leg. As night fast approaches and temperatures drop below freezing, how will these two brothers survive?

programme.title: Fight to Survive S3 - "Nightmare Canyon - Part 2"
programme.desc: After Justin Harris severely breaks his leg deep in a remote, Utah canyon, it ‘s up to his brother Jeremy to climb out for help. Clawing his way through icy pools of water and up rock faces, pushes Jeremy to his limit.

programme.title: Fight to Survive S3 - "Under The Desert Sun"
programme.sub-title: S03 : E03 Under The Desert Sun
programme.desc: Ed Rosenthal set out for a short hike in Joshua Tree National Park, but in the heat of the day he became turned around and lost. His six-day ordeal of survival in blazing temperatures with no food or water is nothing short of miraculous.

programme.title: Fight to Survive S3 - "Tree Stand Nightmare"
programme.desc: When avid bow hunter, Dr. Joe Baumgardner sets out to do routine maintenance on his tree stands, a twenty two foot fall leaves him with a severely broken leg and miles from help in the deep Mississippi woods.

programme.title: Fight to Survive S3 - "Crushed By A Boulder - Part 1"
programme.sub-title: S03 : E05 Crushed By A Boulder - Part 1
programme.desc: While solo climbing Mt. Goddard, a remote peak in the California Sierra, Gregg Hein’s leg is crushed by a boulder and he’s sent careening down the mountain. Barely able to stop his fall, he’s now faced with a horrific compound fracture.

programme.title: Fight to Survive S3 - "Crushed By A Boulder - Part 2"
programme.sub-title: S03 : E06 Crushed By A Boulder - Part 2
programme.desc: After his leg is crushed by a boulder, Gregg Hein is stranded on a high Sierra peak with an infected compound fracture. Knowing he won’t be reported missing for days, Gregg attempts to crawl off the mountain and rescue himself.

programme.title: Fight to Survive S3 - "Iraqi Sniper Attack"
programme.desc: On deployment in Anbar Province, Marine Corp Master Sergeant Buck Doyle throws himself in harm's way to save a fallen comrade from an Iraqi sniper and becomes a target himself. This is a story of survival on and off the battlefield.

programme.title: Fight to Survive S3 - "Lightning Strike"
programme.desc: A bass fishing trip goes horribly wrong when a bolt of lightning strikes their boat, leaving Seventeen-year-old Christian Neal burned and unconscious and his father Gabe blown into the water and paralyzed. It will take a miracle to save them.

programme.title: Fight to Survive S3 - "Mountain Lion Attack"
programme.desc: Marine Anne Hjelle was mountain biking when she was ripped off her bike by a mountain lion. Anne fought back even as the big cat shredded her face in its jaws. Surviving the attack was only the beginning of Anne’s incredible fight to survive.

programme.title: Fight to Survive S3 - "Soul Of A Survivor"
programme.sub-title: S03 : E10 Soul Of A Survivor
programme.desc: Craig DeMartino examines the stories of other survivors he’s met across the season. Their survival stories are all different, but Craig discovers that these survivors share more in common than you might think.

programme.title: The New Fly Fisher S17 - "Stanley's Resort"
programme.desc: Mark Melnyk visits NW Ontario to experience early season smallmouth bass action.

programme.title: The New Fly Fisher S17 - "Arluk Outfitter's"
programme.desc: We re-visit the famed Main River in Northern Newfoundland to fly fish for wild Atlantic Salmon.

programme.title: The New Fly Fisher S17 - "Carolyn Beach Motel"
programme.desc: Alyx Parks & Colin McKeown are on a DIY early season smallmouth bass trip to located big pre-spawn bass!

programme.title: The New Fly Fisher S17 - "Cree River Lodge"
programme.desc: Jenna & Alyx visit northern Saskatchewan to catch giant pike and walleye on a fly. While there, they catch a new IGFA record fish!

programme.title: The New Fly Fisher S17 - "Clarion River"
programme.desc: Rob Heal visits the beautiful PAGO region of Pennsylvania and fishes the Clarion River for both Brown Trout and Smallmouth Bass.

programme.title: Chasing Monsters: El Nino S1 - "Big Wave World Tour"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Big Wave World Tour
programme.desc: Trevor Carlson puts everything on the line to chase monster waves from Maui, Hawaii to Ensenada, Mexico.

programme.title: Chasing Monsters: El Nino S1 - "Skimboarding Jaws"
programme.desc: Brad Domke aims for the big wave surfing history books by skimming the big waves of Pe’ahi.

programme.title: The Great Wall with Ash Dykes S1 - "The First Wall"
programme.desc: Ash’s journey along the Great Wall of China begins at the furthest point to the East, at an ancient section known as the Chu Great Wall. After that, Ash heads to the Shaolin Temple in Dengfeng City, to learn some of their ancient practices.

programme.title: The Great Wall with Ash Dykes S1 - "Underwater"
programme.desc: Starting at Old Dragon’s Head, Ash continues west to meet a Wall Protector who has dedicated his life to preserving this iconic monument, before gearing up for an unexpected adventure: scuba diving the ruins of the Great Wall of China.

programme.title: The Great Wall with Ash Dykes S1 - "Beijing and beyond"
programme.desc: Ash has made it to Beijing, where he’s meeting Terry Townsend to learn more about wildlife conservation in the region around the Great Wall of China. He also meets two more Wall Protectors and samples local delicacies in Shi Xia Village.

programme.title: Food Unknown S1 - "Russia"
programme.desc: Jonathan faces his toughest challenge yet as he enters a country that has been coming to grips in defining and understanding their own cuisine. Through the historical turmoil and harsh climate, Russia has lost it’s traditional way of cooking, and eating. But the country is reviving this culture; Jonathan ventures the far stretches of the country to learn about modern cooks, as well as ancient kitchens housing the one key tool that gave birth to true Russian cuisine, the Russian oven. He’ll learn their insights, understand their efforts, and work with traditional Russian ingredients to learn what the cuisine used to be, and where it’s headed today.

programme.title: Journeys in India S1 - "Mumbai & Goa"
programme.desc: Join us as we explore the Gateway to India—Mumbai. From its early history, it’s many foreign occupations to the hustle and bustle of today. Bill tells Mumbai’s rich history is told through two of its most famous inhabitants, Gandhi and Kipling.

programme.title: Journeys in India S1 - "Gir: The last refuge of the Lion"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E10 Gir: The last refuge of the Lion
programme.desc: The desert of Gujarat is hardly the place one expects to encounter a lion, but in the scrub forest of the region Bill does exactly that. Join him as he tracks the lion and many less dangerous creatures from spotted deer to owls and parrots.

programme.title: Journeys in India S1 - "Kathmandu and Chitwan National Park"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E11 Kathmandu and Chitwan National Park
programme.desc: Just north of India is a land steeped in mystery—Nepal. Bill tours the city of Kathmandu, visits the World Heritage temple complexes, and walks along the city streets, where ancient and modern vie for space.

programme.title: Travel in Style S1 - "BRAZIL & SWEDEN"
programme.desc: In this episode our lucky crew stay in perhaps one of the most famous hotels on the planet – Copacabana Palace. In Sweden we stay in a really cool hotel that’s only just been built!

programme.title: Travel in Style S2 - "MEXICO & EAST ORIENT EXPRESS"
programme.sub-title: S02 : E01 MEXICO & EAST ORIENT EXPRESS
programme.desc: Forget Cancun for a luxury Mexico break – meet Maroma! In Asia, the train glides through a lush tropical Malaysia into the heart of buzzing Bangkok.

programme.title: Travel in Style S2 - "FRANCE & PRAGUE"
programme.desc: We visit the medieval walled city of Carcassonne. Part two finds us in another city steeped in history chasing gastronomic delights in Prague.

programme.title: Weekend Breaks with Gregg Wallace S2 - "Istanbul"
programme.desc: Gregg Wallace discovers Istanbul in 3 days, savoring local flavors, visiting top sights, and trying his hand at kebab making.

programme.title: Weekend Breaks with Gregg Wallace S2 - "Budapest"
programme.desc: Gregg Wallace spends 3 days in Budapest, uncovering its invasion-shaped food culture and exploring the city on foot and by Cold War jeep.

programme.title: Weekend Breaks with Gregg Wallace S2 - "Munich"
programme.desc: Gregg Wallace discovers Munich’s Bavarian food and history over 3 days, revealing how the region helped shape Germany.

programme.title: The Coolest Places on Earth S1 - "Beaches, Castles, and the Happiest Place on Earth"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E08 Beaches, Castles, and the Happiest Place on Earth
programme.desc: Find happiness in the sun-drenched Florida Keys, trek through the rugged Scottish Highlands, and discover the stunning coastal waterfalls of Croatia.

programme.title: The Coolest Places on Earth S1 - "The World’s Coolest Ruins"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E09 The World’s Coolest Ruins
programme.desc: Globetrot through time to visit the Great Pyramid of Giza and the Great Wall of China, discovering the mysteries behind the world’s grandest temples.

programme.title: The Coolest Places on Earth S1 - "Australian Adventure"
programme.desc: Head down under to surf Sydney’s beaches, trek the legendary outback to reach the top of Uluru, and meet the unique wildlife of Kangaroo Island.

programme.title: The Great Wall with Ash Dykes S1 - "Beijing and beyond"
programme.desc: Ash has made it to Beijing, where he’s meeting Terry Townsend to learn more about wildlife conservation in the region around the Great Wall of China. He also meets two more Wall Protectors and samples local delicacies in Shi Xia Village.

programme.title: The Great Wall with Ash Dykes S1 - "Eagle's Neck"
programme.desc: In his toughest challenge so far, Ash takes on Eagle’s Neck – a notoriously steep and dangerous section of the Great Wall of China. But first, he meets tech experts who’ve been helping to digitally map The Great Wall in an effort to protect it.

programme.title: The Great Wall with Ash Dykes S1 - "Inner Mongolia"
programme.desc: Following the Great Wall west, Ash heads to Inner Mongolia to meet up with a nomadic family and to try Mongolian wrestling. He’s hoping to visit Naadam Festival, which features a key part of Mongolian culture: horseracing.

programme.title: Journeys in India S1 - "Tamil Nadu: Chennai, Pondicherry and Much More"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E12 Tamil Nadu: Chennai, Pondicherry and Much More
programme.desc: Chennai, formerly known as Madras, can trace its roots back to a tiny fishing village. Bill explores the city’s growth under the British East India Company, with visits to Fort St. George and the Fort Museum.

programme.title: Journeys in India S1 - "Old and New Delhi…A City of Contrasts"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E13 Old and New Delhi…A City of Contrasts
programme.desc: We explore the capital of India. The bustling metropolis is filled with modern skyscrapers that stand side-by-side with hundreds of ancient monuments, making Delhi a physical dichotomy of yesterday and tomorrow.

programme.title: Journeys in India S2 - "Great Caves of Ajanta and Ellora"
programme.sub-title: S02 : E01 Great Caves of Ajanta and Ellora
programme.desc: The Hindu, Buddhist and Jain caves in these two UNESCO sites contain some of the most beautiful carvings and paintings found in Asia. This episode explores the history and relationship between these religions.

programme.title: A Taste of Travel S1 - "Roman Fortress, Ravensthorpe"
programme.desc: Skye samples the local produce in the Barossa Farmers market while Alana visits an amazing Roman Fortress built into a rock formation dating back 230 million years and Scotty samples some of the local delicacies at Ravensthorpe.

programme.title: A Taste of Travel S1 - "Mildura, Melbourne"
programme.desc: Alana’s back in her home town of Mildura while Scotty taps into his creative side in Melbourne and then continues his trip through the Kimberley with stops in Bells Gorge and Mount Hart.

programme.title: A Taste of Travel S1 - "Bucharest, the Barossa"
programme.desc: Scotty tackles the best the Kimberley can offer and Alana visits Bucharest in Romania also known as little Paris while Skye tastes a Vietnamese treat in the Barossa.

programme.title: Travel in Style S2 - "JERSEY & ITALY"
programme.desc: Nestled some 12 miles off Normandy France lays the beautiful channel Island of Jersey. Part two we fly across to Portofino in Italy.

programme.title: Travel in Style S2 - "SCOTLAND & SWITZERLAND"
programme.desc: It’s a royal theme in part one as we stay in the royal mile of Edinburgh in Scotland in the famous Balmoral Hotel now owned by Rocco Forte. In Switzerland we discover the lake based city of Geneva with its famous landmark the Jet d’Eau.

programme.title: Travel in Style S2 - "FRANCE"
programme.desc: In Paris we visit Hotel le Meurice and Hotel Plaza Athenee, then head down south to sunny Cannes and stay in the Carlton made famous of course by Elton John.

programme.title: The Coolest Places on Earth S1 - "New Zealand: Adventure Capital of the World"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E11 New Zealand: Adventure Capital of the World
programme.desc: Leap, soar, and climb through the "Land of the Long Clouds." This high-octane trip pushes limits with Kiwi-style thrills and impossible heights.

programme.title: The Coolest Places on Earth S1 - "The World’s Coolest Landmarks"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E12 The World’s Coolest Landmarks
programme.desc: Grab your passport for a tour of 20 celebrated sites, from the bright lights of New York and the Kremlin to the fairytale Neuschwanstein Castle.

programme.title: The Coolest Places on Earth S1 - "The Coolest American Cities"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E13 The Coolest American Cities
programme.desc: Go cross-country from sea to shining sea to discover the unique culture, bright lights, and iconic architecture that make American cities so cool.

programme.title: Weekend Breaks with Gregg Wallace S2 - "Madeira"
programme.desc: Gregg Wallace heads to Madeira for winter sun, whale watching, forest hikes, iconic basket rides, and a deep dive into local food and wine.

programme.title: Weekend Breaks with Gregg Wallace S1 - "Vienna"
programme.desc: Gregg Wallace heads to the home of the Christmas market, Vienna, to get to the bottom of what makes them so special, checking out great festive food, fascinating traditions and warming drinks!

programme.title: Weekend Breaks with Gregg Wallace S1 - "Rome"
programme.desc: Gregg Wallace heads to the Italian Capital, Rome, for a Weekend Break. Over the course of 3 days he eats amazing local dishes, tours the sights – both by foot and by scooter - and even tries his hand as a Gladiator.

programme.title: Breaking Beyond S1 - "NYC, USA"
programme.desc: Four BC One World Final legends from our series, Ronnie, Neguin, Junior and Shigekix, are coming to NYC. These legends will meet some of the future legends taking part in this year’s world final and take them on a journey through hip hop history.

programme.title: Breaking Beyond S1 - "Goma, Congo"
programme.desc: Bboy Junior is going back where he was born, The Democratic Republic of Congo. World champion Shigekix will join him, visiting Africa for the first time. Together they will explore the dance culture in the city of Goma.

programme.title: A Simple Path S2 - "Switzerland"
programme.desc: Lugano, home of Morel, Oops Bar and The Warriors. To Basel for cheesy potatoes, DIY with Oli and Claudia, Pipoz, Portland Bowl, the president, creative concrete and wood and the Rock n' Rollers. Back to The Beast then love underground at Bern Moosweg

programme.title: A Simple Path S2 - "Berlin"

Driving from headhunting tribal villages, to step-back-in-time colonial towns, to restaurants in the shadow of the American military behemoth an intriguing story slowly pieces together. Featuring fine work from a top-notch cast that includes the inimitable Maureen OHara at the height of her illustrious career, Peckinpahs first foray into film provides a promising glance into the energetic and violent nature of his iconic later works.

programme.title: Brothers of the West
programme.desc: Tom Tyler plays Tom Wade, a range detective whose brother has been accused of robbery and murder. Wade has only one clue to prove his brothers innocence: a set of unusual tire tracks. This film was directed by Sam Katzman, who later became known as Jungle Sam for his association with a variety of jungle thrillers, and then as a master of all exploitation genres, from teen horror to flying saucer flicks!

programme.title: The Fighting Redhead
programme.desc: When a rustler named Faro kills one of his own henchmen and blames it on Sheila O'Conner, Red and Little Beaver set out to clear Sheila and to find evidence against Faro and his gang.

programme.title: Rawhide Rangers
programme.desc: Blackie's gang is creating havoc and the Ranger, Brand Calhoun and his brother go to investigate.

programme.title: Springtime in the Sierras
programme.desc: Ads for this Roy Rogers classic roared HEAD FOR THE MUSICAL HILLS...ROY IS GUNNIN' FOR THRILLS! And thrills are what you'll get when you watch this fun, action packed B-Western from Republic Pictures. There's some great comic relief from Andy Devine and Chester Conklin, two of Hollywood's all-time greats. This old-fashioned shoot-'em-up was directed by William Witney, who would go on to direct many of television's top western sagas, including Bonanza, Wagon Train, and The Wild, Wild West.

programme.title: My Pal Trigger
programme.desc: Roy Rogers goes to jail after hes wrongly accused of killing Gabby Hayes horse in this action packed yarn from Republic Pictures. All of the old jokes about cowboys kissing their horse may have started with this very movie, as it focuses on Roys loving relationship with Trigger, the greatest horse in all of Hollywood. The film also features Roys beloved Dale Evans, plus, adding some country swing to the musical numbers is Roys favorite backing band, the Sons of the Pioneers! Songs include Ole Faithful, Long, Long Ago and Livin Western Style.

programme.title: Boots and Saddles
programme.desc: When a young Englishman inherits a ranch, none other than Gene Autry takes up the challenge of turning the Brit into a real westerner. He convinces the Brit to use the ranch to raise horses, but things quickly grow complicated. Look for the usual cast of characters from Republic Pictures, including Smiley Burnette (as the irresistible Frog Millhouse!). Songs include Take Me Back To My Boots and Saddle, and Ridin the Range.

programme.title: Arizona Bound
programme.desc: The Rough Riders are called upon to help save a stagecoach line. From 1941, starring Buck Jones and Tim McCoy, plus Horace Murphy and Luana Walters. Directed by Spencer Bennett.

programme.title: Wildfire: The Story of a Horse
programme.desc: Fanning (John Miljan) has his men rustle horses and then blame it on a wild horse named Wildfire. Happy and Alkali arrive and immediately get into trouble with Fanning and his men. When Alkali is shot, Happy catches the outlaws but the Judge not only releases them, he discharges the Sheriff and tries to arrest Happy for rustling! Starring Bob Steele and Sterling Holloway, directed by Robert Emmett Tansey. 1945 (Color).

programme.title: Robin Hood of the Pecos
programme.desc: Roy Rogers finds himself elected sheriff in a wild Texas town after the Civil War. But can Roy handle a place under martial law? And can he save Gabby Hayes from being executed? And how many songs will he get to sing? Clear the burrs from your saddle and get ready for a good one, also starring Marjorie Reynolds, plus Sally Payne as Belle Starr, Queen of the Oklahoma Outlaws!

programme.title: The Hanged Man
programme.desc: After a condemned gunfighter (Steve Forrest) survives his own hanging, he helps a young widow stop a pitiless land baron from taking her ranch. This television feature boasts a strong cast of recognizable characters, including Will Geer, Sharon Acker, Dean Jagger, BarBara Luna, and Cameron Mitchell. Director Michael Caffey would go on to work on such hit shows as Barnaby Jones and MacGyver. Also, look for John Mitchum, younger brother of Robert, in a small role. This movie originally aired on ABC-TV and was considered the pilot for a possible series. Writer/producer Andrew Fenady was behind several opular TV shows such as Branded and The Rebel, as well as the 1970 John Wayne feature, Chisum.

programme.title: Tulsa
programme.desc: Susan Hayward stars in this dramatic tale of the Oklahoma oil boom. She plays Cherokee Lansing, a determined young woman out to protect her father's honor after he's killed by men from a competing oil company. With a cast that includes Robert Preston, Ed Begley, and Pedro Armendariz, this engaging picture from producer Walter Wanger (Cleopatra, I Want to Live!) was nominated for an Academy Award in the Special Effects category. Also, listen for veteran character actor Chill Wills as the narrator!

programme.title: Under California Stars
programme.desc: Disaster strikes when Roy Rogers's beloved horse Trigger is stolen and held for ransom money. Will Roy find $100,000 to get his faithful companion back, or will he find a way to trap the gang holding the horse hostage? Along with Roy and Trigger, you'll find Andy Devine as Cookie Bullfincher, and young Michael Chapin as Ted Carver, a gallant boy who helps reunite Roy with the smartest horse in show business!

programme.title: Cowboy And The Prizefighter
programme.desc: Red Ryder takes Steve Stevenson, who has saved his life, to his ranch and gives him a job. Red's aunt, the Duchess, knew Steve's father, who supposedly committed suicide after losing his ranch betting on a prizefight. Steve refuses to believe that his father took his own life, suspecting he was murdered. Red and Little Beaver aid Steve in finding his father killer.

programme.title: Hell Town
programme.desc: In Hell Town (aka Born to the West) John Wayne is back in the saddle as two-fisted Dare Rudd, a roaming cowhand trying to prove he can win a woman's love and outwit a crooked saloon owner. This exciting B-movie from Paramount Pictures was based on a novel by western writer Zane Grey. With a wild and wooly cast that includes Johnny Mack Brown, Marsha Hunt, Monte Blue, and Lucian Littlefield, director Charles Barton (Abbott and Costello Meet Frankenstein) gives us a tale of romance, action, and high stakes gambling!

programme.title: In Old Colorado
programme.desc: Hopalong Cassidy and his crew get involved in a war over water rights in this feature from Harry Sherman Productions and Paramount Pictures. The intrigue starts when crafty Joe Weller (Morris Ankrum) turns two ranchers against each other, which leads to dire results. This is the 33rd of 66 Hopalong Cassidy movies, with WIlliam Boyd in the role he made famous. Also, look for regular Hoppy co-stars Russell Hayden as Lucky Jenkins, and Andy Clyde as California Carson.

programme.title: Hoppy Serves a Writ
programme.desc: Sheriff Hopalong Cassidy triumphs again in this lighthearted western romp from Harry Sherman Productions. Good ol' Hoppy (William Boyd) has to leave his beloved Texas to track down some bad guys in Oklahoma. You can bet that the action and suspense will follow Hopalong wherever he goes. Also, look for a number of familiar faces in the ast, including TV's future Superman George Reeves, notorious Hollywood heavy Victor Jory, and in his first credited role, Robert Mitchum! In fact, Mitchum would appear in more of Hoppy's adventures before branching out on his own and becoming one of Hollywood's greatest stars. Also featuring Jan Christy, Forbes Murray, Byron Foulger, Earle Hodgins, and Roy...

programme.title: The Light of Western Stars
programme.desc: Knights of the sage-brush roar across the plains in this western drama from Harry Sherman Productions. Victor Jory ( Papillon, Gone With The Wind), stars as a ranch foreman wrongly arrested for murder. The memorable cast includes Tom Tyler (Stage Coach, Adventures of Captain Marvel), plus Noah Beery Jr (The Rockford Files) and in one of his earliest feature roles, Alan Ladd (The Blue Dahlia, Shane).

programme.title: Riders of the Deadline
programme.desc: The 50th of 66 Hopalong Cassidy films finds Hoppy in a vengeful mood. When his good friend Tim Mason is unjustly sent to jail and then killed when trying to escape, Hoppys bitterness gets him drummed out of the Texas Rangers. With the help of his pals California Carson and Jimmy Rogers, he sets out to expose the real culprits and clear Tims name. The usual cast is here, including William Boyd as Hoppy, plus Andy Clyde, Jimmy Rogers, and in one of his earliest roles, Robert Mitchum.

programme.title: High Lonesome
programme.desc: A young drifter is suspected of murder in this stirring production from writer/director Alan Le May (best known for writing The Searchers). John Drew Barrymore stars as Cooncat, a troubled young man who has to steal to survive. With no friends in West Texas, he falls in with some bad customers who involve him in some terrible crimes. The strong cast includes Chill Wills, Jack Elam, and John Archer, with cinematography by Oscar winner W. Howard Greene.

programme.title: Born to Battle
programme.desc: Cyclone Tom Saunders starts a ruckus in a Chinese laundry and has to go before a judge. Unable to pay his fine, he is bailed out by a local cattle rancher and agrees to do 30 days' work for him. It's not too long before he becomes enmeshed in a war between rustlers and outlaws.

programme.title: The Gunman from Bodie
programme.desc: The Rough Riders, a popular group that thrilled audiences in the early 1940s, are after a gang of rustlers in this B-western from Hollywood's Poverty Row. Starring Buck Jones, Tim McCoy, and Raymond Hatton, this movie features everything from lawmen going undercover to the Rough Riders looking after an orphaned baby! Also, be on the lookout for the beautiful Christine McIntyre, who would go on to appear in several of the Three Stooges shorts for Colombia Pictures.

programme.title: Gunsmoke Ranch
programme.desc: Flagg is relocating flood victims to Gunsmoke Ranch. The Three Mesquiteers know Flagg to be a crook and try to warn them. They ignore the warning and improve the land only to find that it has been condemned for a new dam.

programme.title: Sitting Bull
programme.desc: A cavalry officer sympathetic to the wronged Sioux tribe fixes a meeting between Chief Sitting Bull and President Grant but a dishonest Indian Agent and a hateful General Custer test the Sioux's patience, threatening to derail the peace-talks. Directed and co-written by Sidney Salkow; starring Dale Robertson, Mary Murphy, J. Carrol Naish. Also, look for legendary character actor Iron Eyes Cody as Crazy Horse.

programme.title: Song of Arizona
programme.desc: This Roy Rogers adventure finds Gabby Whitaker (Gabby Hayes) running a ranch for wayward boys. One of the boys uses stolen money to help Gabby pay off his debts, but things unravel when the boys father, a notorious outlaw named King Blaine, is murdered; the rest of the Blaine gang show up at Gabbys looking for the loot! Director Frank McDonald works with a fine cast, including Dale Evans, Lyle Talbot, and of course, Roys beloved horse Trigger.

programme.title: Hands Across The Border
programme.desc: Roy Rogers and Trigger star in this Republic Pictures western about horse breeders vying for a contract with the U.S. Army. The cast also includes such favorites as Onslow Stevens and Guinn Big Boy Williams, while songs include Hey Hey (It's a Great Day), Dreaming to Music, and The Girl with the High Button Shoes. For movie buffs: The music for the title song, Hands Across the Border, was composed by none other than Hoagy Carmichael!

programme.title: Public Cowboy No. 1
programme.desc: Gene Autry and Smiley Burnette are back, and this time theyre dealing with some very modern thinking rustlers. These new criminals have taken up the latest technologies to outsmart the authorities, including shortwave radios and airplanes! Can Gene and Smiley get em? You bet! Songs include The West Aint What It Used To Be, I Got the HeebieJeebie Blues, and The Defective Detective from Brooklyn. Gene also gets romantic when he sings, I Picked up the Trail when I Found You...

programme.title: Under Western Stars
programme.desc: Roy Rogers debuts in his starring role as the likable cowboy sent to Congress with a mission: let Washington know about the suffering of farmers in the wake of America's 1930s Dustbowl. Enjoy the singing cowboy in his first starring role, rubbing shoulder with politians, going up against greedy executives, and representing a whole people group you'll see why Rogers became a national icon! Frog Millhouse: Smiley Burnett. Elanore Fairbanks: Carol Hughes. John Fairbanks: Guy Usher. Plus music and singing from the Maple City Four. (The song Dust was nominated for an Academy Award!) Directed by Joe Kane.

programme.title: Grand Canyon Trail
programme.desc: Roy Rogers and Trigger star in this Republic Pictures feature about the hunt for silver in a deserted ghost town. Songs include 'Colorado Joe' and 'Everything's Going My Way'. Plus, look for Andy Devine as Cookie Bullfincher. Film buffs should look for silent screen foil James Finlayson, a familiar face from various Keystone Cop comedies, as the local sheriff.

programme.title: Colorado
programme.desc: Theres trouble out west! Its the Civil War and the Union needs troops back east to defend itself. Roy Rogers stars as Lieutenant Jerry Burke, who is sent to investigate why the returning troops are being stalled in Colorado. Also starring Gabby Hayes, Pauline Moore, and Milburn Stone, this film is action packed with a turn you wont see coming!

programme.title: Daniel Boone, Trailblazer
programme.desc: Daniel Boone (Bruce Bennett) battles Shawnee warriors as he leads a band of settlers into Kentucky in this frontier potboiler from Albert C. Gannaway Productions. Made at the height of Hollywood's fascination with pioneer days, the film also stars Lon Chaney Jr. as Chief Blackfish, and country singer Faron Young as a handsome young suitor for Boone's daughter. There's plenty of action and danger here as the Shawnee are convinced that Boone is trying to steal their land. But Boone is ready, not even fearing death by tomahawk. It isn't how you die, Boone says. It's what you live for.

programme.title: Rawhide
programme.desc: Baseball superstar Gehrig is one of several ranchers being coerced by a bunch of bandits. His sister and her lawyer/lover organize the ranchers. Directed by Ray Taylor; starring Smith Ballew, Gehrig, Evelyn Knapp. Talk about stunt casting! Gehrig was a New York Yankees star who was nearing the end of his career, but one of the biggest sports stars in the country. In the movie he plays a variation of himself, as Lou Gehrig, a retired baseball player who takes up ranching. Lou expects to relax on his ranch but quickly joins other ranchers in a fight to protect their properties.

programme.title: Yellowneck
programme.desc: Location shooting in the Florida Everglades add to this dramatic tale of five Confederate deserters trying to get to Cuba. First, they must overcome snake bites, unfriendly Seminoles, and their own conflicts with each other. How many of the five will actually make it out alive? Lin McCarthy, Stephen Courtleigh, and Berry Kroeger star in this little known example of 1950s independent filmmaking.

programme.title: The Lucky Texan
programme.desc: John Wayne stars in this vintage western. He and George Gabby Hayes strike it rich with a gold mine, only to find their lives complicated by women and crooked officials. Things get even messier when the good guys are framed for murder! Its all action here, particularly since legendary stuntman Yakima Cannut stars as one of the films heavies. Who will win the fight over the gold and the girl? Directed by Robert N. Bradbury for Monogram Pictures. Also starring Barbara Sheldon. (The film was also known as Gold Strike River.)

programme.title: Wagon Trail
programme.desc: The son of Sheriff Clay Hartley, of the frontier town Elder, has gotten into bad company and hangs out with an outlaw gang in which, Collins, owner of the Golden Rule Saloon, is the secret head. Sheriff Hartley suspects him, but has been unable to gather the needed evidence. Collins instructs his gang, including young Hartley, to hold up the stagecoach on its return trip from Missionary Flats and take the cargo of gold dust it is carrying. Sheriff Hartley is notified of the planned holdup by one of his deputies who has been spying on Collins, and organizes a posse. A deputy-sheriff is killed in the ensuing gunfight between the lawmen and the outlaws, but Deputy Joe Larkin, pursues and...

programme.title: One-Eyed Jacks
programme.desc: Dad Longworth robs a Mexican bank, takes the loot, and leaves his partner Rio to be captured. However, Rio escapes capture and searches for Dad in California.

programme.title: The Deadly Companions
programme.desc: An unholy alliance! Marking the feature film debut of one of Hollywoods most influential and widely referenced auteur directors, Sam Peckinpah, The Deadly Companions centers on a redemptive journey to escort a funeral procession through dangerous Indian Territory. Featuring fine work from a top-notch cast that includes the inimitable Maureen OHara at the height of her illustrious career, Peckinpahs first foray into film provides a promising glance into the energetic and violent nature of his iconic later works.

programme.title: Last of the Clintons
programme.desc: Icon of early talking pictures, Harry Carey (Red River), portrays the rugged Trigger Carson, a noble cowboy who infiltrates an outlaw gang in order to expose their rackets. Ordered to kidnap a young girl, his identity is revealed and he is forced to fight his way out of the gang and back to safety. Already 56 by the time he signed on to do this and a series of Westerns for Berke Productions, the stately Carrey (who netted an Oscar nomination four years later) was widely lauded at the time for adding a great deal of maturity and respectability due to his undeniable presence and strong performances.

programme.title: Neath Canadian Skies
programme.desc: It's the mounties versus claim jumpers in this drama from Golden Gate Pictures. Based on an action-packed novel by James Oliver Curwood and directed by B. Reeves Maynard (Undersea Kingdom, The Phantom Empire), the film features an outstanding cast of Poverty Row regulars, including Russell Hayden, Inez Cooper, Cliff Nazarro, I. Stanford Jolley, and Kermit Maynard. For movie buffs: Cinematographer Marcel Le Picard began his career in the silent era and finished with exactly 200 credits!

programme.title: Red Ryder: Ride, Ryder, Ride!
programme.desc: Red Ryder encounters bandits trying to hold up the stagecoach carrying the owner of the Devil's Hole newspaper, Libby Brooks and her brother Gerry. Red successfully drives off the attackers but becomes embroiled in further conflict, leading to a duel that nearly claims his life.

programme.title: Fighting Fury
programme.desc: A THRILLING TALE OF REVENGE AND REDEMPTION! Based on the story Triple Cross for Danger by the widely lauded Western author Walter J. Coburn, Fighting Fury is a thrilling take on the Western revenge drama. Portraying both a father and his son, star of silent and sound cowboy adventure films, Jack Hoxie (Trouble Busters, Law and Lawless) exudes the classic American rustic charm that still defines the genre. The film spins the yarn of Clay Hill Jr. (Hoxie), a Spanish-American boy raised by a Mexican servant who vows bloody vengeance on three malicious ranchers after they murder his parents and turn his life upside down. Featuring fine supporting performances from genre heavies Helen Holmes,...

programme.title: Abilene Town
programme.desc: Ablaze with guns and guts and glory! Randolph Scott headlines as a star studded cast in this yarn about battling homesteaders. Director Edwin L. Marin (Tall in the Saddle) spins this dramatic post-Civil War tale that takes place in the legendary cow town of Abilene, Kansas, coaxing fine performances from the likes of Ann Dvorak, Edgar Buchanan, Thonda Fleming, and Lloyd Bridges. Saddle up and hang on!

programme.title: Shine on Harvest Moon
programme.desc: Jackson and his gang are cattle rustlers holed up in Jackson Hole Wyoming. Roy's partner Brower was once Jackson's partner and is now suspected of being in cahoots with him. Someone is tipping off Jackson as to the cattle's whereabouts and when Roy learns who it is he has a plan to trap Jackson and clear his partner. Starring Roy Rogers, Lynne Roberts, and Myrtle Wiseman as 'Lulu Belle. Directed by Joseph Kane.

programme.title: Days of Jesse James
programme.desc: Famed American western actor and singer Roy Rogers once again plays himself in this Jesse James tale that's a twist on the familiar formula. When he is summoned to bring Jesse to justice after the known villain is suspected of a bank robbery, Rogers soon discovers that Jesse has been framed and that the owner of the bank has robbed his own bank posing as Jesse. Fast-paced and fun, this classic Roy Rogers western directed by Joseph Kane (Dakota) features a whole host of original songs sung by the great Rogers himself.

programme.title: Colorado Sundown
programme.desc: Murder among ranchers is the subject of this Republic Pictures drama. Starring such names as Rex Allen, Slim Pickins, and Chester Clute, this feature was directed by William Whitney. For Trivia Buffs: At one time Whitney was known as the youngest director in Hollywood, having been hired by the newly formed Republic Pictures at the tender age of 21.

programme.title: Code of the Fearless
programme.desc: Fred Scott plays a lawman who goes undercover to expose a dangerous gang of criminals in this action-packed drama. He also has time to sing three songs: Cactus Pete, Gonna Ride, and Heres Romance. Screenwriter Fred Myton would go on to write such offbeat features as Nabonga, and Border Phantom.

programme.title: New Mexico
programme.desc: What happens when Abraham Lincoln himself comes to New Mexico to discuss a treaty with Native American chief Acoma (Ted de Corsia)? Can the hotbed of emotions be quieted by cavalry Captain Hunt (Lew Ayres)? Or will the Captains superiors insist on provoking with the native tribe? Find out what happens in this fictional tale packed with action from 1951!

programme.title: Enemy of the Law
programme.desc: Tex Ritter stars in this western drama about a man who goes undercover to befriend a convict believed to have stolen a shipment of government gold. Also starring Guy Wilkerson as Panhandle Perkins, this offering from Hollywoods Poverty Row features the usual fistfights and entertaining storyline that made these modestly budgeted features well worth watching. Songs include Teach Me To Forget and You Will Have to Pay both sung by Tex!

programme.title: Heartland
programme.desc: A widow with a young daughter travels to a ranch in Wyoming to manage the household of a rancher. After a while the man and woman develop a relationship that leads to a marriage. But life in the harsh place takes its toll.

programme.title: Hurricane Horseman
programme.desc: Pancho Gomez kidnaps Don Roberto and his daughter, Tonita for ransom. Can an undercover lawman named Gun Smith save the pair, or will he be caught himself?! Smith gets a job in Gomez's camp supposedly to repair their guns. Instead he fixes the guns so they will misfire. When Gomez refuses to let him go, he sends his horse for the Sheriff! This campy western from 1931 stars Lane Chandler and is sure to keep you enthralled from beginning to end. Directed by Armand Schaefer; starring Marie Quillan and Walter Miller.

programme.title: Six Gun Trail
programme.desc: Legendary cowboy star Tim McCoy stars as Captain William Carson, who along with his sidekick Magpie does battle with jewel thieves. Its an actionfilled drama of the West, with plenty of blazing guns and heman adventure! There are a couple of songs, too, including Moon Over the Plains but they arent sung by Tim McCoy. He was too darned tough to sing! Also starring Nora Lane, Ben Corbet; directed by Sam Newfield.

programme.title: The Star Packer
programme.desc: He Dared Death In The Outlaw's Lair! John Travers (John Wayne) takes on a mysterious gang leader known as The Shadow in this vintage western from Hollywoods Poverty Row. Director/writer Robert N. Bradbury (Blue Steel, Riders of Destiny) gets the best of a remarkable cast that includes George Gabby Hayes. Of interest to film buffs is that the feature was shot in various California locations by Oscar winning cinematographer Archie Stout (The Quiet Man).

programme.title: Raiders of Red Gap
programme.desc: Bob's Playin' A Mystery Hand... He's Marked For Death By Killer Bullets As Gunfire Echoes Over The Plains! After one of his ranch hands is killed when a gang attacks his ranch, Jim Roberts joins forces with his neighbor in an effort to fight off the Bennett Cattle Co., a company looking to rob them of their land. Things get increasingly dangerous as the company hires Butch Crane, a professional killer, to stop them. Directed by Sam Newfield (Racing Luck (1935), Go-Get-Em, Haines (1936)), Raiders of Red Gap stars Robert Livingston (The Three Mesquiteers (1936), Larceny on the Air (1937)) as Rocky (Lone Rider) Cameron and Al St. John (Billy the Kid Trapped (1942), Border Feud (1947)) as...

programme.title: Raiders of Old California
programme.desc: The end of the Mexican-American War finds a brazen U.S. Calvary captain and his men taking over a Spanish land grant. Albert C. Gannaway (The Badge of Marshall Brennan) directs an all-star cast including Jim Davis (Jock Ewing of Dallas), Arleen Whelan (Young Mr. Lincoln) and Lee Van Cleef (The Good, The Bad, and the Ugly). Also, look for appearances by legendary country & western stars Marty Robbins and Faron Young.

programme.title: The Fighting Westerner
programme.desc: A mining engineer tries to solve the murders of several heirs to a valuable radium mine in this western drama from Paramount Pictures. Stars include Charles Chic Sale, and in one of his early roles, Randolph Scott. This feature, also known as Rocky Mountain Mystery, was directed by Oscar winner Charles Barton, who would go on to direct several popular television shows, including Petticoat Junction and Family Affair...

programme.title: Work on the Wild Side
programme.desc: View risky cheetah anesthesia, meet mongooses, and bond with an orphan rhino.

programme.title: Work on the Wild Side

programme.title: Malini Angelica Lisbon
programme.desc: Malini Angelica explores Lisbon, the vibrant capital of Portugal. Once founded by the Phoenicians and shaped by Romans, Moors, and explorers of the Golden Age, Lisbon’s layered history is reflected in its culture and charm. During her visit, the city comes alive with the Festas Populares de Lisboa — a June celebration of Saint Anthony filled with music, dancing, and barbecued sardines. Malini samples local favorites like grilled sardines, bifanas, and the famous pastel de nata, and experiences the soulful beauty of Fado music. Lisbon’s warmth, flavor, and festive spirit show why it remains one of Europe’s most beloved cities.

programme.sub-title: Concerto - Schubert e Strauss per Mariotti e OSN
programme.desc: The Rai National Symphony Orchestra, under the baton of conductor Michele Mariotti, presents a captivating performance featuring the works of Franz Schubert and Richard Strauss. The programme showcases Schubert's rich melodies and lyrical compositions alongside Strauss's dynamic and expressive pieces, offering a journey through the Romantic and late-Romantic musical landscapes. The orchestra's interpretation highlights the depth and emotional power of these renowned composers, creating a memorable concert experience.

programme.title: Whats On Trade, Exhibitions and Unique Experiences
programme.sub-title: Whats On Trade, Exhibitions and Unique Experiences
programme.desc: There is a unique energy that takes over the Mediterranean as the summer heat begins to build. This week, we are bypassing the usual tourist routes to find the heartbeat of the region through its most spectacular festivals. Imagine the sun setting over a lake in Tuscany as the Puccini Festival opens its 72nd season with the powerful melodies of Turandot. From that timeless elegance, we head straight into the high energy of Malta, where the Isle of MTV and the 10th anniversary of the Glitch Festival are turning the islands into a global hub for electronic music. We also explore the stunning heights of the Spanish Pyrenees for the floating stage at Pirineos Sur and hit the iconic cliffs of Santorini for the urban vibes of the Supa Dupa Fly Festival. This is a journey through a region that knows exactly how to celebrate its past while dancing firmly into the future.

programme.desc: Dolly’s schelp rolt bergafwaarts een kuil in die in de rivier uitkomt. Dolly draagt nu bladeren en een paddenstoel, maar Boes vindt een ton, een zak of een kuip een beter idee. Dolly is er niet blij mee en wil haar schelp terug.

programme.title: Boes
programme.sub-title: S01 : E29 Boes: Boes en de bijen
programme.desc: Boes houdt van honing. Op een dag volgt hij een honingbij en vindt het nest van de bij. Maar helaas is een beer hem te snel af en eet alle honing op! De bij denkt dat Boes zijn honing op heeft gegeten en prikt hem.

programme.title: Boes
programme.sub-title: S01 : E30 Boes: Een huis vol
programme.desc: Als moeder kraai babykonijnen naar haar nest brengt, waar haar kuikens hongerig wachten op eten, vechten de konijnen dapper en winnen. Moeder kraai moet iets anders verzinnen en steelt de lunch van Boes. Boes vraagt zich af wanneer de kraai vegetariër is geworden.

programme.title: Symfollies
programme.desc: De familie viool geniet van een dagje aan zee. Tijdens hun spel vinden de kinderen een fles. Er zit een schatkaart in. Stradi en Viola zijn erg nieuwsgierig en gaan op zoek naar de schat.

programme.title: Symfollies
programme.desc: Stradi en Viola wandelen in een boomgaard. Ze willen graag appels plukken, maar kunnen er niet bij. Dan komen Bassoon en Tuba voorbij. O ja, zij zullen hen wel een handje kunnen toesteken! Maar willen de heren dat wel?

programme.title: Symfollies
programme.sub-title: S01 : E13 Symfollies: De Gebroken Ruit
programme.desc: Bass en Celine slapen nog, en de kinderen gaan al wat in de tuin spelen. De bal belandt pardoes in de ruit van de slaapkamer van de ouders. Stradi en Viola vluchten naar hun kamer. Dan vindt Bass de bal, en…

programme.title: Symfollies
programme.desc: Het is een hete zomerdag. Stradi wil graag een ijsje, maar Bass noch Viola willen hem geld geven. Dan komt Horn de boel op stelten zetten, en om zijn fouten goed te maken, tracteert hij het hele gezelschap. Stradi gaat de ijsjes kopen, maar wil zelf het allergrootste…

programme.title: Symfollies
programme.desc: Stradi verveelt zich te pletter. Plots ziet hij een luchtballon. Horn wenkt hem voor een tochtje. Terwijl niemand op hem let, stapt hij in. Hoog in de lucht ziet hij sterren en planeten. Hij plukt zelfs een ster uit de hemel.

programme.title: Symfollies
programme.desc: De hele vioolfamilie is met vakantie. Bij een bergwandeling willen ze de hoogste top bereiken. Ze verliezen de moed niet, overwinnen enkele moeilijkheden, en staan uiteindelijk op de top. Of niet?

programme.title: De Smurfen

Samen keren ze zich tegen Gargamel en zijn snode plan valt in het water. Grote Smurf slaagt er uiteindelijk ook in om Smurfin een meer smurfse look te geven.

programme.title: Mouk

programme.title: Symfollies
programme.desc: Stradi en Ting Tang spelen met de knikkers. De magische knikker van Ting Tang staat op het spel. Als Stradi hem wint, loopt hij ermee naar Viola. Dan blijkt dat de knikker alleen maar magische kracht heeft in de handen van Ting Tang.

programme.title: Symfollies
programme.desc: Stradi is aan het rolschaatsen in het park. Plots komt daar de aantrekkelijke Pica voorbij. Hij raakt op slag verliefd. Door zijn rolschaatstalent te tonen, probeert hij indruk op haar te maken. Maar dat loopt slecht af.

programme.title: Symfollies
programme.desc: De vioolkinderen spelen in het bos. Ze ontdekken rare, immens grote sporen. Die moeten van een groot beest komen, denken ze. Ze gaan op jacht, maar al gauw blijkt dat Ting Tang hier voor iets tussen zit.

programme.title: Symfollies
programme.desc: Stradi doet zijn uiterste best om een vlieger op te laten, maar het lukt hem niet. Viola is geen hulp: ze zit een boek over vampiers te lezen. Trump en Tromb geven Stradi een grote vlieger, die hem hoog in de lucht meesleurt. Het wordt een heuse nachtmerrie.

programme.title: Symfollies
programme.desc: Het heeft gesneeuwd. Stradi en Viola glijden op hun slee tot bij de bevroren vijver. Het ijs is in slechte staat, en het is verboden te schaatsen. Maar Bassoon is op het ijs. Plots breekt het onder zijn voeten. De kinderen moeten hem redden, het koste wat het wil.

programme.title: Symfollies
programme.desc: Stradi en Viola planten elk een zaadje in een pot. Viola verzorgt het kiemende plantje heel goed, maar Stradi speelt liever buiten. Als hij merkt dat zijn plant veel kleiner is dan die van Viola, komt een lelijk karaktertrekje in hem naar boven.

En het water in de regenton is bijna verdampt. Hitte in de stad…

Het is namelijk een tijdje geleden. Eve heeft het de afgelopen maanden iets rustiger gehad. Britt laat jullie zien hoe ze het rijden weer oppakt met Eve.

programme.desc: Het is weer tijd voor een paardenrassen video. Britt en Esra laten je onder andere het fjordenpaard, de Haflinger en de Spaanse Andalusiër zien. Wat maakt deze rassen zo bijzonder? Britt en Esra zoeken het voor jullie uit.

programme.desc: Britt vertelt een aantal dingen die je nooit moet doen in de buurt van de manege of de paarden! Ook krijgen paardenmensen vaak dingen te horen die echt super stom zijn. In deze video vertelt Esra 10 dingen die je nooit meer wilt horen.

programme.title: Paardenpraat TV

programme.title: Paardenpraat TV

programme.title: Paardenpraat TV
